payload.title: Preserve attached literal hash suffixes in Markdown heading titles
payload.summary: On authenticated main a4274bd190bf7ee16c4f8077410617dd37461157, exported MarkdownFile parses "# C#" as title "C". find_heading("C#") and find_section("C#") consequently return None. Its optional closing-hash pattern consumes attached title characters without the space/tab boundary of a closing marker. Repair only the existing structural Markdown owner; preserve literal hashes and strip only a separated terminal hash run.
payload.benefit: Keep programming-language and other hash-suffixed titles intact so existing heading/section lookups find the intended source. Preserve existing levels, whitespace trimming, empty headings, fence handling, section boundaries, original content and model APIs. One-file repair, frozen public tests and independent private acceptance.
payload.uncertainty: Authored in-memory reproduction, no observed production document loss. Markdown remains a narrow helper; no inline escape decoding, Setext, new indentation grammar, source-slice fidelity or full CommonMark parser. Existing fence-closer repair is delivered and separate; B-0049/50/51 and B-0052 remain unchanged.
dependencies: Existing filesystem Markdown model and codec; standing Intake and exact native grants; independent review; separate integration authority.
